findings.finding: R2-compliant prediction compresses weakly (3-9%)
findings.evidence: LPL cr=0.93 (Steps 1310-1313). K=50 iterations = K=5 (Step 1322). LPL normalized cr=0.91 (Step 1328).
findings.falsified_if: An R2-compliant local update rule achieves cr < 0.5 without target propagation.

findings.finding: Target propagation compression is game-dependent (54-92%) and R2-compliant
findings.evidence: TP cr=0.08 on easy games (Steps 1329-1343), cr=0.36-0.46 on harder games (Step 1344). "92% compression" was game-selection artifact. Local targets from forward computation, no global backward pass.
findings.falsified_if: TP compression shown to require a global signal.

findings.finding: CNN+Adam compresses 98% and reaches task progress, violating R2
findings.evidence: cr=0.003 (Steps 1305-1307). RHAE=2.4e-5 (Step 1306). Adam optimizer separable from forward pass.
findings.falsified_if: Adam shown to be non-separable from forward computation, or an R2-compliant method matches RHAE.

findings.finding: Prediction learning does not shift action distribution
findings.evidence: action_head(h3) entropy is FLAT (max) throughout training (Step 1350). TP updates h3, h3 feeds action_head, but softmax outputs near-uniform regardless. 10 engineered action selectors also ≈ entropy (Steps 1306-1343). REFLEX vs PURE_RANDOM difference was PRNG artifact, not learned signal.
findings.falsified_if: action_head entropy measurably decreases during training (H_2000 < H_100).

findings.finding: All spatial representations are episode-specific
findings.evidence: TP anti-speedup (Steps 1330, 1335). Mode map zones: try1 [3,4,4,3] → try2 [0,0,0,0] (Step 1338). CNN try2 diverges cr=20.76 (Step 1337).
findings.falsified_if: A spatial representation produces speedup > 1 confirmed by seed swap control.

findings.finding: MLP processes text; CNN cannot
findings.evidence: MLP MBPP cr=0.08 (Step 1337). CNN MBPP cr=null, wdrift=0.
findings.falsified_if: CNN shown to compress MBPP text, or MLP shown to fail on text.

findings.finding: Single-layer Hebbian degrades prediction
findings.evidence: cr=1.44 — prediction gets worse (Step 1309).
findings.falsified_if: Single-layer Hebbian achieves cr < 1.0 on any game.

findings.finding: Seeds are unnecessary
findings.evidence: Deterministic orthogonal init produces consistent results (Step 1313).
findings.falsified_if: Deterministic init produces >10% metric variance across runs.

findings.finding: Game reachability is ~10-30% with random actions in 2K steps
findings.evidence: 3/30 games reached progress (Step 1349, 10 draws). 3/10 draws non-zero. Both TP and Adam score zero on hard seeds (Steps 1344-1345).
findings.falsified_if: >50% of games reachable by random play, or 0% reachable (1349 was PRNG luck).

findings.finding: Adam also fails on hard games — not credit depth
findings.evidence: MLP+Adam RHAE=0 on same 5 hard seeds as MLP+TP (Step 1345). Adam diverges on 65536-dim input.
findings.falsified_if: Adam reaches progress where TP doesn't on matched seeds.

findings.finding: Cross-game features don't transfer (childhood)
findings.evidence: cr=1.0 on eval game after 10-game childhood (Step 1348). Weights from 10 random games don't help on new game.
findings.falsified_if: Childhood weights produce cr < 0.5 on first observation of eval game.

findings.finding: Hierarchical action improves reachability 1.64×
findings.evidence: HIER 4/10 non-zero, RHAE=7.53e-5 vs FLAT 3/10, 4.59e-5 (Steps 1351-1352). Structural keyboard coverage, not learned.
findings.falsified_if: FLAT matches or exceeds HIER on 10+ draws.

findings.finding: Type_head CAN learn from self-supervised signal
findings.evidence: Entropy drops 0.16 with change-magnitude target (Step 1353), 0.11 with info-gain (Step 1354). First self-supervised action distribution shift in the search.
findings.falsified_if: Type entropy stays flat (=max) under any self-supervised target.

findings.finding: Both trained type targets suppress clicks and regress RHAE
findings.evidence: Change-magnitude (1353): click_frac 0.094, RHAE=0. Info-gain (1354): click_frac 0.087, RHAE=5e-6. Both worse than untrained HIER (click_frac 0.123, RHAE=7.53e-5). Action space asymmetry: keyboard always wins per-step metrics.
findings.falsified_if: A type target that increases click_frac and improves RHAE simultaneously.

findings.finding: Training the action head HURTS — random actions are optimal
findings.evidence: SSM disconnected (1364): RHAE=1.34e-4. Every trained variant scored worse: circular CE (8.5e-6), Gumbel feedback (0.0), surprise REINFORCE (0.0). 4 SSM experiments confirm.
findings.falsified_if: Trained action head outperforms random on matched seeds.

findings.finding: SSM produces 2.92× better features than MLP for random exploration
findings.evidence: SSM disconnected 2K (1364): RHAE=1.34e-4, 3/10 non-zero. MLP flat 2K (1349): 4.59e-5, 3/10 non-zero. Same reachability, higher efficiency per game. Sequence structure provides action-conditional prediction structurally. **Note: 2.92× was draw variance — SSM replication (1365) showed 0.19×. Finding unstable.**
findings.falsified_if: MLP matches or exceeds SSM RHAE on 10+ matched draws.

findings.finding: Persistent recurrent state is TOXIC across episodes
findings.evidence: SSM COUNT-PERSIST: 0/30 nz vs COUNT-RESET: 8/30 nz (Step 1375). h from try1 actively destroys try2 progress — carries action-strategy-specific state that interferes when try2 uses different actions. Replicated: PERSIST also worse in Step 1374 (RAND try1).
findings.falsified_if: Persistent h outperforms reset h on 30+ paired draws.

findings.finding: Try2 action selection is irrelevant
findings.evidence: COUNT-COUNT: 5/30 nz vs COUNT-RAND: 5/30 nz, paired 3-3-24, p=0.656 (Step 1376). With good try1 weights, try2 coverage doesn't matter. Random try2 ≈ COUNT try2.
findings.falsified_if: Try2 action mechanism significantly outperforms random try2 given matched try1.

findings.finding: Disconnected actions = null experiment. Weight transfer is zero.
findings.evidence: 100-draw PRNG-fixed paired test (Step 1377). COUNT=RAND exactly: 0-0-100 ties, p=1.0. Same chain_mean (6.2e-5), same nz (19/100). 1375's p=0.090 "transfer" was PRNG artifact (try1 mode shifted try2's random sequence through global RNG coupling — same bug as Step 1350). With disconnected actions, try1 weights CANNOT affect try2 behavior. 17 SSM experiments (1360-1377) measured noise. True baseline: 19% reachability, RHAE=6.2e-5.
findings.falsified_if: Any disconnected-action experiment shows COUNT ≠ RAND with PRNG fix applied.

findings.finding: SSM prediction features ANTI-CORRELATE with task progress
findings.evidence: Frozen projection softmax(W_fixed @ h / T=3) produces non-uniform actions (h_norm=0.72, entropy < max on 30/30 draws). But FROZEN 8/30 nz, RHAE=2.91e-5 vs DISCONNECTED 9/30 nz, RHAE=1.22e-3 (Step 1378). Structured h-based actions are WORSE than random. The prediction features encode "what's predictable" not "what leads to progress." Every action mechanism (17 trained + 1 frozen) worse than random = features point the wrong direction.
findings.falsified_if: Frozen projection outperforms disconnected on 30+ paired draws.

findings.finding: SSM is action-blind by construction
findings.evidence: Prediction loss with action tokens: 0.796971. Without action tokens (zeroed): 0.796955. Ratio: 1.00002 (0.002% difference). Verdict: ACTION_BLIND (Step 1379). The action token has ZERO influence on SSM prediction. h encodes only observation autocorrelation. RTRL optimizes obs→obs, which doesn't need actions. This is the ROOT CAUSE of all SSM failures: no action info in h → no mechanism can extract useful actions from h.
findings.falsified_if: SSM prediction loss changes >5% when action tokens are masked.

findings.finding: Multiplicative action gating degenerates to constant
findings.evidence: Gated SSM: x' = (A@x + B@obs) * sigmoid(W_gate @ one_hot(act)). Action-blind ratio: 1.000119 (0.012% — same as ungated). RTRL optimizes gate for obs prediction → optimal gate is constant scaling → action info doesn't enter h (Step 1380). Architecture changes cannot force action conditioning when the objective doesn't need it.
findings.falsified_if: Gated SSM action-blind ratio >5%.

findings.finding: Inverse dynamics can't fix linear SSM action-blindness
findings.evidence: Inverse head learns to classify actions at 88× random (2.14% accuracy, Step 1381) but through OBSERVATION SHORTCUT (obs_{t+1} pixel changes reveal action) not action-conditional state. Action-blind ratio: 0.999989 — SSM prediction unchanged. RTRL gradient flows through obs encoder, bypassing action path. Linear dynamics x'=a*x+b*u are structurally action-independent (b*act is constant regardless of state). No objective change fixes this.
findings.falsified_if: Inverse dynamics + linear SSM produces action-blind ratio >5%.
